versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאֶֽל־אַהֲרֹ֔ן בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses and Aaron in the land of Egypt, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão na terra do Egito, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: הַחֹ֧דֶשׁ הַזֶּ֛ה לָכֶ֖ם רֹ֣אשׁ חֳדָשִׁ֑ים רִאשׁ֥וֹן הוּא֙ לָכֶ֔ם לְחָדְשֵׁ֖י הַשָּׁנָֽה׃

controles.web: “This month shall be to you the beginning of months. It shall be the first month of the year to you.
controles.kjv: This month shall be unto you the beginning of months: it shall be the first month of the year to you.
controles.livre: Este mês vos será o princípio dos meses; será este para vós o primeiro nos meses do ano.

versos.hebraico: דַּבְּר֗וּ אֶֽל־כָּל־עֲדַ֤ת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בֶּעָשֹׂ֖ר לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַזֶּ֑ה וְיִקְח֣וּ לָהֶ֗ם אִ֛ישׁ שֶׂ֥ה לְבֵית־אָבֹ֖ת שֶׂ֥ה לַבָּֽיִת׃

controles.web: Speak to all the congregation of Israel, saying, ‘On the tenth day of this month, they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to their fathers’ houses, a lamb for a household;
controles.kjv: Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel, saying, In the tenth day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb, according to the house of their fathers, a lamb for an house:
controles.livre: Falai a toda a congregação de Israel, dizendo: No dia dez deste mês tome para si cada um um cordeiro pelas famílias dos pais, um cordeiro por família:

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־יִמְעַ֣ט הַבַּיִת֮ מִהְיֹ֣ת מִשֶּׂה֒ וְלָקַ֣ח ה֗וּא וּשְׁכֵנ֛וֹ הַקָּרֹ֥ב אֶל־בֵּית֖וֹ בְּמִכְסַ֣ת נְפָשֹׁ֑ת אִ֚ישׁ לְפִ֣י אָכְל֔וֹ תָּכֹ֖סּוּ עַל־הַשֶּֽׂה׃

controles.web: and if the household is too little for a lamb, then he and his neighbor next to his house shall take one according to the number of the souls; according to what everyone can eat you shall make your count for the lamb.
controles.kjv: And if the household be too little for the lamb, let him and his neighbour next unto his house take it according to the number of the souls; every man according to his eating shall make your count for the lamb.
controles.livre: Mas se a família for pequena que não seja capaz de comer o cordeiro inteiro, então tomará a seu vizinho imediato à sua casa, e segundo o número das pessoas, cada um conforme seu comer, fareis a conta sobre o cordeiro.

versos.hebraico: שֶׂ֥ה תָמִ֛ים זָכָ֥ר בֶּן־שָׁנָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם מִן־הַכְּבָשִׂ֥ים וּמִן־הָעִזִּ֖ים תִּקָּֽחוּ׃

controles.web: Your lamb shall be without defect, a male a year old. You shall take it from the sheep, or from the goats:
controles.kjv: Your lamb shall be without blemish, a male of the first year: ye shall take it out from the sheep, or from the goats:
controles.livre: O cordeiro será sem defeito, macho de um ano; vós o tomareis das ovelhas ou das cabras:

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֤ה לָכֶם֙ לְמִשְׁמֶ֔רֶת עַ֣ד אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר י֖וֹם לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַזֶּ֑ה וְשָׁחֲט֣וּ אֹת֗וֹ כֹּ֛ל קְהַ֥ל עֲדַֽת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֵּ֥ין הָעַרְבָּֽיִם׃

controles.web: and you shall keep it until the fourteenth day of the same month; and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it at evening.
controles.kjv: And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month: and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening.
controles.livre: E o guardareis até o dia catorze desse mês; e toda a congregação do povo de Israel o imolará ao entardecer.

versos.hebraico: וְלָֽקְחוּ֙ מִן־הַדָּ֔ם וְנָֽתְנ֛וּ עַל־שְׁתֵּ֥י הַמְּזוּזֹ֖ת וְעַל־הַמַּשְׁק֑וֹף עַ֚ל הַבָּ֣תִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־יֹאכְל֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בָּהֶֽם׃

controles.web: They shall take some of the blood, and put it on the two door posts and on the lintel, on the houses in which they shall eat it.
controles.kjv: And they shall take of the blood, and strike it on the two side posts and on the upper door post of the houses, wherein they shall eat it.
controles.livre: E tomarão do sangue, e o porão nos dois postes e na verga das casas em que o comerão.

versos.hebraico: וְאָכְל֥וּ אֶת־הַבָּשָׂ֖ר בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַזֶּ֑ה צְלִי־אֵ֣שׁ וּמַצּ֔וֹת עַל־מְרֹרִ֖ים יֹאכְלֻֽהוּ׃

controles.web: They shall eat the flesh in that night, roasted with fire, and unleavened bread. They shall eat it with bitter herbs.
controles.kjv: And they shall eat the flesh in that night, roast with fire, and unleavened bread; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it.
controles.livre: E naquela noite comerão a carne assada ao fogo, e pães sem levedura; com ervas amargas o comerão.

versos.hebraico: אַל־תֹּאכְל֤וּ מִמֶּ֨נּוּ֙ נָ֔א וּבָשֵׁ֥ל מְבֻשָּׁ֖ל בַּמָּ֑יִם כִּ֣י אִם־צְלִי־אֵ֔שׁ רֹאשׁ֥וֹ עַל־כְּרָעָ֖יו וְעַל־קִרְבּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Don’t eat it raw, nor boiled at all with water, but roasted with fire; with its head, its legs and its inner parts.
controles.kjv: Eat not of it raw, nor sodden at all with water, but roast with fire; his head with his legs, and with the purtenance thereof.
controles.livre: Nenhuma coisa comereis dele crua, nem cozida em água, mas sim assada ao fogo; sua cabeça com seus pés e seus intestinos.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹא־תוֹתִ֥ירוּ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַד־בֹּ֑קֶר וְהַנֹּתָ֥ר מִמֶּ֛נּוּ עַד־בֹּ֖קֶר בָּאֵ֥שׁ תִּשְׂרֹֽפוּ׃

controles.web: You shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; but that which remains of it until the morning you shall burn with fire.
controles.kjv: And ye shall let nothing of it remain until the morning; and that which remaineth of it until the morning ye shall burn with fire.
controles.livre: Nenhuma coisa deixareis dele até a manhã; e o que houver restado até a manhã, queimareis no fogo.

versos.hebraico: וְכָכָה֮ תֹּאכְל֣וּ אֹתוֹ֒ מָתְנֵיכֶ֣ם חֲגֻרִ֔ים נַֽעֲלֵיכֶם֙ בְּרַגְלֵיכֶ֔ם וּמַקֶּלְכֶ֖ם בְּיֶדְכֶ֑ם וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם אֹתוֹ֙ בְּחִפָּז֔וֹן פֶּ֥סַח ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה׃

controles.web: This is how you shall eat it: with your belt on your waist, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and you shall eat it in haste: it is Yahweh’s Passover.
controles.kjv: And thus shall ye eat it; with your loins girded, your shoes on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and ye shall eat it in haste: it is the Lord’s passover.
controles.livre: E assim tereis de comê-lo: cingidos vossos lombos, vossos calçados em vossos pés, e vosso bordão em vossa mão; e o comereis apressadamente: é a Páscoa do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְעָבַרְתִּ֣י בְאֶֽרֶץ־מִצְרַיִם֮ בַּלַּ֣יְלָה הַזֶּה֒ וְהִכֵּיתִ֤י כָל־בְּכוֹר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם מֵאָדָ֖ם וְעַד־בְּהֵמָ֑ה וּבְכָל־אֱלֹהֵ֥י מִצְרַ֛יִם אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה שְׁפָטִ֖ים אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: For I will go through the land of Egypt in that night, and will strike all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and animal. Against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgments: I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night, and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both man and beast; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: Pois eu passarei naquela noite pela terra do Egito, e ferirei todo primogênito na terra do Egito, tanto nos homens como nos animais; e executarei juízos em todos os deuses do Egito. EU SOU O SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָה֩ הַדָּ֨ם לָכֶ֜ם לְאֹ֗ת עַ֤ל הַבָּתִּים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתֶּ֣ם שָׁ֔ם וְרָאִ֨יתִי֙ אֶת־הַדָּ֔ם וּפָסַחְתִּ֖י עֲלֵכֶ֑ם וְלֹֽא־יִֽהְיֶ֨ה בָכֶ֥ם נֶ֨גֶף֙ לְמַשְׁחִ֔ית בְּהַכֹּתִ֖י בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: The blood shall be to you for a token on the houses where you are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and there shall no plague be on you to destroy you, when I strike the land of Egypt.
controles.kjv: And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you, when I smite the land of Egypt.
controles.livre: E o sangue vos será por sinal nas casas onde vós estejais; e verei o sangue, e passarei de vós, e não haverá em vós praga de mortandade, quando ferirei a terra do Egito.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָה֩ הַיּ֨וֹם הַזֶּ֤ה לָכֶם֙ לְזִכָּר֔וֹן וְחַגֹּתֶ֥ם אֹת֖וֹ חַ֣ג לַֽיהוָ֑ה לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם תְּחָגֻּֽהוּ׃

controles.web: This day shall be to you for a memorial, and you shall keep it a feast to Yahweh: throughout your generations you shall keep it a feast by an ordinance forever.
controles.kjv: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial; and ye shall keep it a feast to the Lord throughout your generations; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever.
controles.livre: E hoje vos será em memória, e tereis de celebrá-lo como solenidade ao SENHOR durante vossas gerações; por estatuto perpétuo o celebrareis.

versos.hebraico: שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ מַצּ֣וֹת תֹּאכֵ֔לוּ אַ֚ךְ בַּיּ֣וֹם הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן תַּשְׁבִּ֥יתוּ שְּׂאֹ֖ר מִבָּתֵּיכֶ֑ם כִּ֣י׀ כָּל־אֹכֵ֣ל חָמֵ֗ץ וְנִכְרְתָ֞ה הַנֶּ֤פֶשׁ הַהִוא֙ מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִיּ֥וֹם הָרִאשֹׁ֖ן עַד־י֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִעִֽי׃

controles.web: “‘Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread; even the first day you shall put away yeast out of your houses, for whoever eats leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.
controles.kjv: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses: for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day, that soul shall be cut off from Israel.
controles.livre: Sete dias comereis pães sem levedura; e assim o primeiro dia fareis que não haja levedura em vossas casas; porque qualquer um que comer levedado desde o primeiro dia até o sétimo, aquela alma será eliminada de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וּבַיּ֤וֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן֙ מִקְרָא־קֹ֔דֶשׁ וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י מִקְרָא־קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם כָּל־מְלָאכָה֙ לֹא־יֵעָשֶׂ֣ה בָהֶ֔ם אַ֚ךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵאָכֵ֣ל לְכָל־נֶ֔פֶשׁ ה֥וּא לְבַדּ֖וֹ יֵעָשֶׂ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: In the first day there shall be to you a holy convocation, and in the seventh day a holy convocation; no kind of work shall be done in them, except that which every man must eat, that only may be done by you.
controles.kjv: And in the first day there shall be an holy convocation, and in the seventh day there shall be an holy convocation to you; no manner of work shall be done in them, save that which every man must eat, that only may be done of you.
controles.livre: No primeiro dia haverá santa convocação, e também no sétimo dia tereis uma santa convocação; nenhuma obra se fará neles, exceto somente que prepareis o que cada qual houver de comer.

versos.hebraico: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֮ אֶת־הַמַּצּוֹת֒ כִּ֗י בְּעֶ֨צֶם֙ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אֶת־צִבְאוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֞ם אֶת־הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֛ה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶ֖ם חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this same day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt: therefore you shall observe this day throughout your generations by an ordinance forever.
controles.kjv: And ye shall observe the feast of unleavened bread; for in this selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt: therefore shall ye observe this day in your generations by an ordinance for ever.
controles.livre: E guardareis a festa dos pães ázimos, porque em este mesmo dia tirei vossos exércitos da terra do Egito: portanto guardareis hoje em vossas gerações por costume perpétuo.

versos.hebraico: בָּרִאשֹׁ֡ן בְּאַרְבָּעָה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֤וֹם לַחֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ בָּעֶ֔רֶב תֹּאכְל֖וּ מַצֹּ֑ת עַ֠ד י֣וֹם הָאֶחָ֧ד וְעֶשְׂרִ֛ים לַחֹ֖דֶשׁ בָּעָֽרֶב׃

controles.web: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, you shall eat unleavened bread, until the twenty first day of the month at evening.
controles.kjv: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at even, ye shall eat unleavened bread, until the one and twentieth day of the month at even.
controles.livre: No mês primeiro, o dia catorze do mês pela tarde, comereis os pães sem levedura, até o vinte e um do mês pela tarde.

versos.hebraico: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים שְׂאֹ֕ר לֹ֥א יִמָּצֵ֖א בְּבָתֵּיכֶ֑ם כִּ֣י׀ כָּל־אֹכֵ֣ל מַחְמֶ֗צֶת וְנִכְרְתָ֞ה הַנֶּ֤פֶשׁ הַהִוא֙ מֵעֲדַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בַּגֵּ֖ר וּבְאֶזְרַ֥ח הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: There shall be no yeast found in your houses for seven days, for whoever eats that which is leavened, that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he be a foreigner, or one who is born in the land.
controles.kjv: Seven days shall there be no leaven found in your houses: for whosoever eateth that which is leavened, even that soul shall be cut off from the congregation of Israel, whether he be a stranger, or born in the land.
controles.livre: Por sete dias não se achará levedura em vossas casas, porque qualquer um que comer algo levedado, tanto estrangeiro como natural do país, aquela alma será eliminada da congregação de Israel.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־מַחְמֶ֖צֶת לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֑לוּ בְּכֹל֙ מוֹשְׁבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם תֹּאכְל֖וּ מַצּֽוֹת׃פ

controles.web: You shall eat nothing leavened. In all your habitations you shall eat unleavened bread.’”
controles.kjv: Ye shall eat nothing leavened; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread.
controles.livre: Nenhuma coisa levedada comereis; em todas as vossas habitações comereis pães sem levedura.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְרָ֥א מֹשֶׁ֛ה לְכָל־זִקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֑ם מִֽשְׁכ֗וּ וּקְח֨וּ לָכֶ֥ם צֹ֛אן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתֵיכֶ֖ם וְשַׁחֲט֥וּ הַפָּֽסַח׃

controles.web: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said to them, “Draw out, and take lambs according to your families, and kill the Passover.
controles.kjv: Then Moses called for all the elders of Israel, and said unto them, Draw out and take you a lamb according to your families, and kill the passover.
controles.livre: E Moisés convocou a todos os anciãos de Israel, e disse-lhes: Tirai, e tomai para vós cordeiros por vossas famílias, e sacrificai a páscoa.

versos.hebraico: וּלְקַחְתֶּ֞ם אֲגֻדַּ֣ת אֵז֗וֹב וּטְבַלְתֶּם֮ בַּדָּ֣ם אֲשֶׁר־בַּסַּף֒ וְהִגַּעְתֶּ֤ם אֶל־הַמַּשְׁקוֹף֙ וְאֶל־שְׁתֵּ֣י הַמְּזוּזֹ֔ת מִן־הַדָּ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּסָּ֑ף וְאַתֶּ֗ם לֹ֥א תֵצְא֛וּ אִ֥ישׁ מִפֶּֽתַח־בֵּית֖וֹ עַד־בֹּֽקֶר׃

controles.web: You shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the basin, and strike the lintel and the two door posts with the blood that is in the basin; and none of you shall go out of the door of his house until the morning.
controles.kjv: And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the bason, and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that is in the bason; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house until the morning.
controles.livre: E tomai um molho de hissopo, e molhai-lhe no sangue que estará em uma bacia, e untai a verga e os dois postes com o sangue que estará na bacia; e nenhum de vós saia das portas de sua casa até a manhã.

versos.hebraico: וְעָבַ֣ר יְהוָה֮ לִנְגֹּ֣ף אֶת־מִצְרַיִם֒ וְרָאָ֤ה אֶת־הַדָּם֙ עַל־הַמַּשְׁק֔וֹף וְעַ֖ל שְׁתֵּ֣י הַמְּזוּזֹ֑ת וּפָסַ֤ח יְהוָה֙ עַל־הַפֶּ֔תַח וְלֹ֤א יִתֵּן֙ הַמַּשְׁחִ֔ית לָבֹ֥א אֶל־בָּתֵּיכֶ֖ם לִנְגֹּֽף׃

controles.web: For Yahweh will pass through to strike the Egyptians; and when he sees the blood on the lintel, and on the two door posts, Yahweh will pass over the door, and will not allow the destroyer to come in to your houses to strike you.
controles.kjv: For the Lord will pass through to smite the Egyptians; and when he seeth the blood upon the lintel, and on the two side posts, the Lord will pass over the door, and will not suffer the destroyer to come in unto your houses to smite you.
controles.livre: Porque o SENHOR passará ferindo os egípcios; e quando vir o sangue na verga e nos dois postes, passará o SENHOR aquela porta, e não deixará entrar o feridor em vossas casas para ferir.

versos.hebraico: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה לְחָק־לְךָ֥ וּלְבָנֶ֖יךָ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: You shall observe this thing for an ordinance to you and to your sons forever.
controles.kjv: And ye shall observe this thing for an ordinance to thee and to thy sons for ever.
controles.livre: E guardareis isto por estatuto para vós e para vossos filhos para sempre.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֞ה כִּֽי־תָבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה לָכֶ֖ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּ֑ר וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־הָעֲבֹדָ֥ה הַזֹּֽאת׃

controles.web: It shall happen when you have come to the land which Yahweh will give you, according as he has promised, that you shall keep this service.
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when ye be come to the land which the Lord will give you, according as he hath promised, that ye shall keep this service.
controles.livre: E será que quando houverdes entrado na terra que o SENHOR vos dará, como tem falado, que guardareis este rito.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֕ה כִּֽי־יֹאמְר֥וּ אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם בְּנֵיכֶ֑ם מָ֛ה הָעֲבֹדָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את לָכֶֽם׃

controles.web: It will happen, when your children ask you, ‘What do you mean by this service?’
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when your children shall say unto you, What mean ye by this service?
controles.livre: E quando vos perguntarem vossos filhos: Que rito é este vosso?

versos.hebraico: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֡ם זֶֽבַח־פֶּ֨סַח ה֜וּא לַֽיהוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר פָּ֠סַח עַל־בָּתֵּ֤י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם בְּנָגְפּ֥וֹ אֶת־מִצְרַ֖יִם וְאֶת־בָּתֵּ֣ינוּ הִצִּ֑יל וַיִּקֹּ֥ד הָעָ֖ם וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוּֽוּ׃

controles.web: that you shall say, ‘It is the sacrifice of Yahweh’s Passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he struck the Egyptians, and spared our houses.’”   The people bowed their heads and worshiped.
controles.kjv: That ye shall say, It is the sacrifice of the Lord’s passover, who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he smote the Egyptians, and delivered our houses. And the people bowed the head and worshipped.
controles.livre: Respondereis: É o sacrifício da Páscoa do SENHOR, que passou nas casas dos filhos de Israel no Egito, quando feriu os egípcios, e livrou nossas casas. Então o povo se inclinou e adorou.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאַהֲרֹ֖ן כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃ס

controles.web: The children of Israel went and did so; as Yahweh had commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.
controles.kjv: And the children of Israel went away, and did as the Lord had commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Israel se foram, e fizeram exatamente assim, como o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés e a Arão.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֣י׀ בַּחֲצִ֣י הַלַּ֗יְלָה וַֽיהוָה֮ הִכָּ֣ה כָל־בְּכוֹר֮ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ מִבְּכֹ֤ר פַּרְעֹה֙ הַיֹּשֵׁ֣ב עַל־כִּסְא֔וֹ עַ֚ד בְּכ֣וֹר הַשְּׁבִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּבֵ֣ית הַבּ֑וֹר וְכֹ֖ל בְּכ֥וֹר בְּהֵמָֽה׃

controles.web: At midnight, Yahweh struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh who sat on his throne to the firstborn of the captive who was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of livestock.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that at midnight the Lord smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sat on his throne unto the firstborn of the captive that was in the dungeon; and all the firstborn of cattle.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que à meia-noite o SENHOR feriu todo primogênito na terra do Egito, desde o primogênito de Faraó que se sentava sobre seu trono, até o primogênito do prisioneiro que estava no cárcere, e todo primogênito dos animais.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֨קָם פַּרְעֹ֜ה לַ֗יְלָה ה֤וּא וְכָל־עֲבָדָיו֙ וְכָל־מִצְרַ֔יִם וַתְּהִ֛י צְעָקָ֥ה גְדֹלָ֖ה בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם כִּֽי־אֵ֣ין בַּ֔יִת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵֽין־שָׁ֖ם מֵֽת׃

controles.web: Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt, for there was not a house where there was not one dead.
controles.kjv: And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt; for there was not a house where there was not one dead.
controles.livre: E levantou-se naquela noite Faraó, ele e todos os seus servos, e todos os egípcios; e havia um grande clamor no Egito, porque não havia casa onde não houvesse morto.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקְרָא֩ לְמֹשֶׁ֨ה וּֽלְאַהֲרֹ֜ן לַ֗יְלָה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ ק֤וּמוּ צְּאוּ֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ עַמִּ֔י גַּם־אַתֶּ֖ם גַּם־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּלְכ֛וּ עִבְד֥וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֖ה כְּדַבֶּרְכֶֽם׃

controles.web: He called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, “Rise up, get out from among my people, both you and the children of Israel; and go, serve Yahweh, as you have said!
controles.kjv: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night, and said, Rise up, and get you forth from among my people, both ye and the children of Israel; and go, serve the Lord, as ye have said.
controles.livre: E fez chamar a Moisés e a Arão de noite, e disse-lhes: Saí do meio de meu povo vós, e os filhos de Israel; e ide, servi ao SENHOR, como dissestes.

versos.hebraico: גַּם־צֹאנְכֶ֨ם גַּם־בְּקַרְכֶ֥ם קְח֛וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּרְתֶּ֖ם וָלֵ֑כוּ וּבֵֽרַכְתֶּ֖ם גַּם־אֹתִֽי׃

controles.web: Take both your flocks and your herds, as you have said, and be gone; and bless me also!”
controles.kjv: Also take your flocks and your herds, as ye have said, and be gone; and bless me also.
controles.livre: Tomai também vossas ovelhas e vossas vacas, como dissestes, e ide; e abençoai também a mim.

versos.hebraico: וַתֶּחֱזַ֤ק מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ עַל־הָעָ֔ם לְמַהֵ֖ר לְשַׁלְּחָ֣ם מִן־הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י אָמְר֖וּ כֻּלָּ֥נוּ מֵתִֽים׃

controles.web: The Egyptians were urgent with the people, to send them out of the land in haste, for they said, “We are all dead men.”
controles.kjv: And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people, that they might send them out of the land in haste; for they said, We be all dead men.
controles.livre: E os egípcios apressavam ao povo, dando pressa a expulsá-los da terra; porque diziam: Todos seremos mortos.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשָּׂ֥א הָעָ֛ם אֶת־בְּצֵק֖וֹ טֶ֣רֶם יֶחְמָ֑ץ מִשְׁאֲרֹתָ֛ם צְרֻרֹ֥ת בְּשִׂמְלֹתָ֖ם עַל־שִׁכְמָֽם׃

controles.web: The people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneading troughs being bound up in their clothes on their shoulders.
controles.kjv: And the people took their dough before it was leavened, their kneadingtroughs being bound up in their clothes upon their shoulders.
controles.livre: E levou o povo sua massa antes que se levedasse, suas massas envoltas em suas mantas sobre seus ombros.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עָשׂ֖וּ כִּדְבַ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַֽיִּשְׁאֲלוּ֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם כְּלֵי־כֶ֛סֶף וּכְלֵ֥י זָהָ֖ב וּשְׂמָלֹֽת׃

controles.web: The children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they asked of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing.
controles.kjv: And the children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they borrowed of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and raiment:
controles.livre: E fizeram os filhos de Israel conforme o mandamento de Moisés, pedindo aos egípcios objetos de prata, e objetos de ouro, e roupas.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיהוָ֞ה נָתַ֨ן אֶת־חֵ֥ן הָעָ֛ם בְּעֵינֵ֥י מִצְרַ֖יִם וַיַּשְׁאִל֑וּם וַֽיְנַצְּל֖וּ אֶת־מִצְרָֽיִם׃פ

controles.web: Yahweh gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they let them have what they asked. They plundered the Egyptians.
controles.kjv: And the Lord gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they lent unto them such things as they required. And they spoiled the Egyptians.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR deu favor ao povo diante dos egípcios, e deram-lhes; e eles despojaram os egípcios.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֧וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מֵרַעְמְסֵ֖ס סֻכֹּ֑תָה כְּשֵׁשׁ־מֵא֨וֹת אֶ֧לֶף רַגְלִ֛י הַגְּבָרִ֖ים לְבַ֥ד מִטָּֽף׃

controles.web: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot who were men, besides children.
controles.kjv: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand on foot that were men, beside children.
controles.livre: E partiram os filhos de Israel de Ramessés a Sucote, como seiscentos mil homens a pé, sem contar os meninos.

versos.hebraico: וְגַם־עֵ֥רֶב רַ֖ב עָלָ֣ה אִתָּ֑ם וְצֹ֣אן וּבָקָ֔ר מִקְנֶ֖ה כָּבֵ֥ד מְאֹֽד׃

controles.web: A mixed multitude went up also with them, with flocks, herds, and even very much livestock.
controles.kjv: And a mixed multitude went up also with them; and flocks, and herds, even very much cattle.
controles.livre: E também subiu com eles grande multidão de diversa variedade de gentes; e ovelhas, e gados muito muitos.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאפ֨וּ אֶת־הַבָּצֵ֜ק אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצִ֧יאוּ מִמִּצְרַ֛יִם עֻגֹ֥ת מַצּ֖וֹת כִּ֣י לֹ֣א חָמֵ֑ץ כִּֽי־גֹרְשׁ֣וּ מִמִּצְרַ֗יִם וְלֹ֤א יָֽכְלוּ֙ לְהִתְמַהְמֵ֔הַּ וְגַם־צֵדָ֖ה לֹא־עָשׂ֥וּ לָהֶֽם׃

controles.web: They baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought out of Egypt; for it wasn’t leavened, because they were thrust out of Egypt, and couldn’t wait, neither had they prepared for themselves any food.
controles.kjv: And they baked unleavened cakes of the dough which they brought forth out of Egypt, for it was not leavened; because they were thrust out of Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they prepared for themselves any victual.
controles.livre: E cozeram tortas sem levedura da massa que haviam tirado do Egito; porque não havia levedado, porquanto expulsando-os os egípcios, não haviam podido deter-se, nem ainda preparar para si comida.

versos.hebraico: וּמוֹשַׁב֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָשְׁב֖וּ בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָֽה׃

controles.web: Now the time that the children of Israel lived in Egypt was four hundred thirty years.
controles.kjv: Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt, was four hundred and thirty years.
controles.livre: O tempo que os filhos de Israel habitaram no Egito foi quatrocentos e trinta anos.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֗י מִקֵּץ֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שָׁנָ֑ה וַיְהִ֗י בְּעֶ֨צֶם֙ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה יָֽצְא֛וּ כָּל־צִבְא֥וֹת יְהוָ֖ה מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: At the end of four hundred thirty years, to the day, all of Yahweh’s armies went out from the land of Egypt.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years, even the selfsame day it came to pass, that all the hosts of the Lord went out from the land of Egypt.
controles.livre: E passados quatrocentos e trinta anos, no mesmo dia saíram todos os exércitos do SENHOR da terra do Egito.

versos.hebraico: לֵ֣יל שִׁמֻּרִ֥ים הוּא֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה לְהוֹצִיאָ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם הֽוּא־הַלַּ֤יְלָה הַזֶּה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה שִׁמֻּרִ֛ים לְכָל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃פ

controles.web: It is a night to be much observed to Yahweh for bringing them out from the land of Egypt. This is that night of Yahweh, to be much observed of all the children of Israel throughout their generations.
controles.kjv: It is a night to be much observed unto the Lord for bringing them out from the land of Egypt: this is that night of the Lord to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations.
controles.livre: É noite de guardar ao SENHOR, por havê-los tirado nela da terra do Egito. Esta noite devem guardar ao SENHOR todos os filhos de Israel em suas gerações.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאַהֲרֹ֔ן זֹ֖את חֻקַּ֣ת הַפָּ֑סַח כָּל־בֶּן־נֵכָ֖ר לֹא־יֹ֥אכַל בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, “This is the ordinance of the Passover. No foreigner shall eat of it,
controles.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses and Aaron, This is the ordinance of the passover: There shall no stranger eat thereof:
controles.livre: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés e a Arão: Esta é a ordenança da Páscoa: Nenhum estrangeiro comerá dela;

versos.hebraico: וְכָל־עֶ֥בֶד אִ֖ישׁ מִקְנַת־כָּ֑סֶף וּמַלְתָּ֣ה אֹת֔וֹ אָ֖ז יֹ֥אכַל בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: but every man’s servant who is bought for money, when you have circumcised him, then shall he eat of it.
controles.kjv: But every man’s servant that is bought for money, when thou hast circumcised him, then shall he eat thereof.
controles.livre: Mas todo servo humano comprado por dinheiro, comerá dela depois que o houveres circuncidado.

versos.hebraico: תּוֹשָׁ֥ב וְשָׂכִ֖יר לֹא־יֹ֥אכַל־בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: A foreigner and a hired servant shall not eat of it.
controles.kjv: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof.
controles.livre: O estrangeiro e o assalariado não comerão dela.

versos.hebraico: בְּבַ֤יִת אֶחָד֙ יֵאָכֵ֔ל לֹא־תוֹצִ֧יא מִן־הַבַּ֛יִת מִן־הַבָּשָׂ֖ר ח֑וּצָה וְעֶ֖צֶם לֹ֥א תִשְׁבְּרוּ־בֽוֹ׃

controles.web: In one house shall it be eaten; you shall not carry out anything of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall you break a bone of it.
controles.kjv: In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.
controles.livre: Em uma casa se comerá, e não levarás daquela carne fora de casa, nem quebrareis osso seu.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־עֲדַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יַעֲשׂ֥וּ אֹתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.
controles.kjv: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it.
controles.livre: Toda a congregação de Israel o sacrificará.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־יָג֨וּר אִתְּךָ֜ גֵּ֗ר וְעָ֣שָׂה פֶסַח֮ לַיהוָה֒ הִמּ֧וֹל ל֣וֹ כָל־זָכָ֗ר וְאָז֙ יִקְרַ֣ב לַעֲשֹׂת֔וֹ וְהָיָ֖ה כְּאֶזְרַ֣ח הָאָ֑רֶץ וְכָל־עָרֵ֖ל לֹֽא־יֹ֥אכַל בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: When a stranger shall live as a foreigner with you, and will keep the Passover to Yahweh, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one who is born in the land: but no uncircumcised person shall eat of it.
controles.kjv: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee, and will keep the passover to the Lord, let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land: for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.
controles.livre: Mas se algum estrangeiro peregrinar contigo, e quiser fazer a páscoa ao SENHOR, seja-lhe circuncidado todo homem, e então se chegará a fazê-la, e será como o natural da terra; mas nenhum incircunciso comerá dela.

versos.hebraico: תּוֹרָ֣ה אַחַ֔ת יִהְיֶ֖ה לָֽאֶזְרָ֑ח וְלַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֥ר בְּתוֹכְכֶֽם׃

controles.web: One law shall be to him who is born at home, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you.”
controles.kjv: One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you.
controles.livre: A mesma lei será para o natural e para o estrangeiro que peregrinar entre vós.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּֽעֲשׂ֖וּ כָּל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽת־אַהֲרֹ֖ן כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃ס

controles.web: All the children of Israel did so. As Yahweh commanded Moses and Aaron, so they did.
controles.kjv: Thus did all the children of Israel; as the Lord commanded Moses and Aaron, so did they.
controles.livre: Assim o fizeram todos os filhos de Israel; como mandou o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão, assim o fizeram.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֕י בְּעֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה הוֹצִ֨יא יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־בְּנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם עַל־צִבְאֹתָֽם׃פ

controles.web: That same day, Yahweh brought the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass the selfsame day, that the Lord did bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt by their armies.
controles.livre: E naquele mesmo dia o SENHOR tirou os filhos de Israel da terra do Egito, agrupados em seus esquadrões.
